title: 计算应缴税款总额
summary: 税级给出各档累计收入上限和税率，计算指定收入应缴纳的税款。
insight: 逐档只对落在上一档上限与当前上限之间的收入征税，最后一档也只取实际收入覆盖部分。
pitfalls: 上限是累计边界而非本档宽度

solutions.title: 累进税档模拟
solutions.idea: 逐段累加实际落入该税档的收入乘税率。
steps: tax+=taxable*percent/100；若 income<=upper 结束，否则 previous=upper

code.java: class Solution { public double calculateTax(int[][] brackets,int income){double tax=0;int previous=0;for(int[] bracket:brackets){int taxable=Math.max(0,Math.min(income,bracket[0])-previous);tax+=taxable*bracket[1]/100.0;if(income<=bracket[0])break;previous=bracket[0];}return tax;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun calculateTax(brackets:Array<IntArray>,income:Int):Double{var tax=0.0;var previous=0;for(bracket in brackets){val taxable=maxOf(0,minOf(income,bracket[0])-previous);tax+=taxable*bracket[1]/100.0;if(income<=bracket[0])break;previous=bracket[0]};return tax} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:double calculateTax(vector<vector<int>>& brackets,int income){double tax=0;int previous=0;for(auto& bracket:brackets){int taxable=max(0,min(income,bracket[0])-previous);tax+=taxable*bracket[1]/100.0;if(income<=bracket[0])break;previous=bracket[0];}return tax;} };
